gaps.sentence: There are many ___ (SIMILAR) between the two languages.
gaps.explanation: 'Many' needs a plural countable noun: similarities (note the -ty to -ties spelling).

gaps.sentence: His ___ (CONFIDENT) was shaken by the failure.
The ___ (PROSPER) of the region depends on tourism.
I'm afraid your passport is ___ — it expired last month (VALID).
gaps.hint: negative adjective needed: it has expired
gaps.explanation: An expired document is invalid (in- + valid); an adjective is needed after 'is'.
'Subtle differences' — the plural noun follows the adjective.

gaps.sentence: The vaccine is still awaiting official ___ (APPROVE).
gaps.explanation: 'Official approval' — the noun form follows the adjective.

gaps.sentence: The meeting has been ___ until Thursday (SCHEDULE).
gaps.hint: arranged for a new time (re-); past participle needed
gaps.explanation: The prefix re- means again/afresh: rescheduled means given a new time. The passive needs the past participle.

gaps.sentence: We had a ___ view of the coast from the plane (SPECTACLE).
gaps.explanation: The adjective of 'spectacle' is spectacular; it modifies the noun 'view'.
